name: Distinguishing Range / Labeled Sample Compression
proof: A distinguishing coordinate set of size \(\mathrm R(\mathcal H)\) gives an injective binary trace map on \(\mathcal H\), so \(\lceil\log_2|\mathcal H|\rceil\le\mathrm R(\mathcal H)\). The mistake-driven halving construction gives a labeled sample-compression scheme of size at most \(\lceil\log_2|\mathcal H|\rceil\). Combining the two bounds yields \(\mathrm{LSC}(\mathcal H)\le\mathrm R(\mathcal H)\).
